title: Inside Deutsche Bank
excerpt: A major global investigation revealing the inner workings of the financial giant, Deutsche Bank.
content_html:
Inside Deutsche Bank: Risky Business

A major global investigation revealing the inner workings of the financial giant. The leak of 15+ million files lays bare the bank's flawed culture, systemic blind spots and pursuit of profit over compliance.

Read more

The Stories

Inside Deutsche Bank: Secrets, scandals and double standards

More than 15-million internal files from the world’s biggest bank leak show an institution battling to stay the course on financial controls.

Read on Daraj Media

Leaked files show Deutsche Bank undermined its climate pledges

The 15 million leaked internal documents offer a rare glimpse of what happened to those promises when they collided with lucrative financial relationships at the heart of one of Europe’s largest banks.

Read on Himal Southasian

Los pagos a la industria del sexo virtual en Colombia que el Deutsche Bank no vigiló

In Colombia, the bank's own investigation found it may have been instrumental in facilitating money laundering, human trafficking, and exploitation, among other crimes.

Read on El Clip

Deutsche Bank’s Illicit Route to Prince Mohammed bin Nayef

Deutsche Bank secured an investment portfolio worth hundreds of millions of dollars linked to Saudi Prince Mohammed bin Nayef and helped establish offshore corporate structures to manage it.

Read on Daraj Media

Leaked Files Show Deutsche Bank Protected Russian Profits Despite Warnings

“As you know we have a large Russian Oligarchs client population,” an analyst wrote as the bank braced for sanctions against wealthy clients.

Read on The New York Times

Studentský účet Michala Fica banka zrušila pro podezření z praní peněz

Raising money laundering red flags, analysts at the bank found that the Slovak PM's son was not paying anything out of his account and was receiving payments from two people closely connected to his father's politics.

Read on Investigace.cz

A decade of dark money: Deutsche Bank’s bet on problematic payments

Deutsche Bank has been sanctioned for failing to flag suspicious transactions properly, and this investigation reveals that it has continued to operate on the edge.

Read on El Clip

Bankrolling attacks in Gaza: how a global bank armed Israel

Documents in the Inside Deutsche Bank leak reveal Deutsche Bank’s role in supplying weapons now used against civilians in Palestine.

Read on Dawn

Deutsche Bank slammed SA regulators, then hailed them as ‘world-class’

The Joburg office first slated local inspectors before a R38m fine. Then, in the same breath, had to praise them to HQ

Read on Financial Mail

Orbán-linked bank was a gateway for Russian money into Europe, files reveal

One of Hungary’s largest banks allegedly platformed a multi-billion-euro money-laundering scheme linked to a Russian oligarch. Deutsche Bank, which processed many of its payments, struggled to curb the wrongdoing.

Read on Follow The Money

Deutsche Bank armata. Anche Leonardo tra i suoi clienti

The Inside Deutsche Bank leak reveals the bank's closeness to the war industry, and how it financed arms supplies to "high-risk" or conflict-ridden countries, violating its own internal policies.

Read on IrpiMedia

Trump, Deutsche Bank and the Russian connection

Deutsche Bank documents connect Trump-owned companies to laundromat schemes.

Read on Financial Mail

“Picaretas não melhoram”, disse executivo do Deutsche Bank sobre André Esteves, do BTG

"Crooks don’t improve miraculously as they get older", said Deutsche bank executive about André Esteves, owner of BTG Pactual, the largest investment bank in Latin America.

Read on Agência Pública

How global banks helped Jho Low escape justice

More than a decade after implicated in the world's largest kleptocracy case, Jho Low remains elusive. Among his enablers was Deutsche Bank, which facilitated at least 24 transactions totalling €172.98 million linked to Low.

Read on Malaysiakini

Leaked documents reveal how dealings with royal dynasty blurred traditional boundaries between investor, client and counterparty
